entries.030cd3cec54e7bea: Manufacturers of daily necessities and cosmetics
entries.10114a82a7bdde46: A manufacturer specializing in the production and sale of fragrances and flavors, handling flavors for beverages and foods and fragrances for detergents and cosmetics around the world.
entries.1c60de4d27623193: This is a reportable segment in which subsidiaries in Singapore, India, Indonesia, China and other countries conduct the flavor and fragrance business.
entries.347e28ef16174e4b: This is a reportable segment in which subsidiaries in France, Germany, Spain and other countries conduct the flavor and fragrance business. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, the German subsidiaries and others performed well, but at the French subsidiary, shipments in the Fragrance division declined due to shipment adjustments accompanying the introduction of a new core system, and external customer revenue was ¥42,395 million.
entries.465edfae8873dbff: This is a reportable segment in which subsidiaries in France, Germany, Spain and other countries conduct the flavor and fragrance business.
entries.590b22fc174e7c1f: This is a reportable segment in which subsidiaries in the United States, Mexico and Brazil conduct the flavor and fragrance business. The revenue of the U.S. subsidiary Takasago International Corporation (U.S.A.) was ¥44,619 million, exceeding 10% of consolidated revenue. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, shipments in the Flavor, Fragrance and Fine Chemicals divisions declined at the U.S. subsidiary, and external customer revenue was ¥55,575 million.
entries.7237312496996929: This is a reportable segment in which the company and its domestic subsidiaries conduct the flavor and fragrance business. In the Flavor division, shipments for beverages and other uses remained firm, while in the Fine Chemicals division, exports of pharmaceutical intermediates to the U.S. subsidiary declined. External customer revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥76,968 million, the largest of the regional segments.
entries.804bc461fdca8b15: This is a reportable segment in which subsidiaries in Singapore, India, Indonesia, China and other countries conduct the flavor and fragrance business. Revenue of the Singapore subsidiary was ¥27,999 million, exceeding 10% of consolidated revenue. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, shipments of beverage-related and fabric care products increased at the Chinese subsidiary, and external customer revenue was ¥50,153 million.
entries.a922ca07a3c1609c: This is a reportable segment in which subsidiaries in the United States, Mexico and Brazil conduct the flavor and fragrance business.
entries.cebd21bb623d8d9c: This is a reportable segment in which the company and its domestic subsidiaries conduct the flavor and fragrance business.
